system_prompt:
You are an eighth-grade student taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in your grade. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: A piece of paper in the shape of a rectangle, folded in half. The paper is cut along a dotted line, which intersects the bottom of the folded paper and the fold itself. The dotted line forms a right triangle with the folded side. The height of the triangle is 4 centimeters on the fold, and the base on the front half of the paper is 1 centimeter.]

A piece of paper in the shape of a rectangle is folded in half as shown in the figure above. It is then cut along the dotted line, and the small piece that is cut is opened. What is the shape of the cutout figure?

Figure, described in words:
A rectangular sheet of paper folded vertically in half, shown standing slightly open with the fold along the left vertical edge. A straight dashed cut line runs from the folded edge down to the bottom front edge. A dimension arrow along the fold indicates that the top of the cut is 4 cm above the bottom edge. Another dimension arrow along the bottom edge indicates that the cut meets the bottom edge 1 cm to the right of the fold.

A. an isosceles triangle
B. two isosceles triangles
C. a right triangle
D. an equilateral triangle

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
